title: YouCoded — round 11: M9 refined, glass and eye options, N3 refined

steps.path: Taskbar, dock, browser tab, the lockups
steps.headline: Which of these icons do you like? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: M9 with the name or initials, M9 bigger, and your M4 — all with the deeper shadow and bright rim.

variants.label: P1 M9 + "youcoded" below
variants.summary: Mascot and name together; the name can't be read below ~48px.

variants.label: P3 M9, bigger
variants.summary: Just the face, as big as the tile allows.

variants.label: P4 M4, deeper shadow
variants.summary: Your pick, popped off the theme's colour.

steps.headline: How blurred should the picture inside the face be?
steps.notice: Same icon four times; only the blur changes. Small sizes underneath each.

variants.label: Heavy blur
variants.summary: Pure colour, like the site's backgrounds.

steps.headline: Which eye style makes it pop? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: Same icon five times; only the eyes change. Small sizes underneath each.

variants.label: Ink + white ring
variants.summary: A white ring lifts them off any colour.

variants.label: Purple glass
variants.summary: Deep purple with a pink inner light.

variants.label: Glow
variants.summary: Dark eyes with a violet glow.

steps.headline: Which version of the box installer do you like? Pick as many as you want.
